title: hotfix: fix connection leak in SLO enforcer causing regional failover thrashing
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: In recent incidents we've observed the SLO enforcer entering rapid regional failover cycles under sustained partial-network degradation. Root cause analysis identified a connection-management bug where short-lived sidecar connections used for health-checks and remote quota checks were not being closed on certain error paths. This leak caused the enforcer to exhaust connection pools and mis-evaluate regional health, resulting in thrashing between primary and fallback regions.

This hotfix: 1) closes connections in all error paths for the quota/health-check client, 2) adds a defensive timeout and backoff for the communication used by the SLO enforcer, 3) tightens the enforcer's regional decision hysteresis when connectivity degrades, 4) adds targeted unit/integration tests that simulate transient failures and connection churn.

Checklist:
- [x] Fix connection close paths and pool accounting
- [x] Add timeout/backoff on client
- [x] Add hysteresis safeguard to regional decisioning
- [x] Add unit + integration tests
- [x] Run load test profile (slo-enforcer-regional-thrashing)

Notes: The fixes are intentionally small and guarded to minimize behavioral drift. We observed the failover-thrashing reproduce locally with the test harness used in perf-canary; after the change the thrash pattern does not occur under the same load profile. This change is targeted for the release/v1.22 branch as a hotfix and should be cherry-picked to main after post-merge verification. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and postmortem actions.

review_comments: Ben Carter: The close-on-error path LGTM. Can we add a metric for connection-leak-count so we can monitor after rollout?
Aisha Patel: Added pool_leak_detected metric and exported to prometheus in connection_pool.rs (see commit b7c8d9e).
Marco Ruiz: Integration test is helpful. Observed one flaky failure on first CI run (timing). Recommend small sleep margin in test to stabilise on CI.
Aisha Patel: Increased retry window and made sleep conditional on ENV CI to avoid masking local flakiness. Reran integration suite
Elena Ivanova: Approval after seeing perf-canary run (no thrash) and CI green. Recommend cherry-pick to main and signal SRE to monitor for 24h post-rollout.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent connection leak in SLO enforcer which could trigger rapid regional failover thrashing under partial-network degradation. Adds connection pool fixes, timeout/backoff, and hysteresis in regional decisioning. Monitor pool_leak_detected metric after rollout.
rollback_instructions: If regressions are observed: 1) Roll back release/v1.22 to the previous tag, 2) disable regional hysteresis tighten flag via remote-config, 3) contact oncall SRE and attach prometheus snapshot for connection_pool and region_decision metrics.
testing_notes: Local reproduction steps included in the integration test. Perf-canary profile run included that reproduces the original thrash pattern; retest using perf-canary/runner with --scenario slo-enforcer-regional-thrashing. Post-merge run on staging for 2 hours recommended before production promotion.
